question: ap1
prompt:
Research question: "What analyses or measurements would best test whether AP-1 acts as a cellular memory mechanism?"

Propose 5 distinct, concrete ideas (analyses, measurements, or experiments) that a research lab could pursue to address this question. For each idea give a short title and a description of one or two sentences.

ideas.title: Inducible, time-resolved AP-1 perturbation with chromatin-memory readout
ideas.description: Use an acute, reversible degron (e.g., dTAG or AID) or optogenetic control to deplete or activate FOS/JUN for defined windows, then track whether chromatin accessibility (ATAC-seq), H3K27ac and AP-1 motif occupancy at enhancers persist after the stimulus is withdrawn. Persistence of these marks without AP-1 present would be direct evidence of memory, while rapid collapse would argue against it.

ideas.title: Stimulus re-exposure (memory recall) assay
ideas.description: Apply a priming stimulus (e.g., a short TNF or growth-factor pulse), allow a rest period, then re-stimulate and compare the magnitude and kinetics of AP-1 target gene induction (RNA-seq, nascent transcription via PRO-seq) with naive cells. Faster or stronger responses on re-challenge, lost when AP-1 binding sites are mutated or AP-1 is degraded during the rest period, would demonstrate a functional memory.

ideas.title: Single-cell lineage tracing of AP-1 activity history
ideas.description: Combine a live AP-1 reporter (e.g., FOS-promoter-driven fluorescent timer or destabilized reporter) with barcoded lineage tracing or CRISPR-based recorders to link each cell's past AP-1 activity to its later transcriptional state after a delay. Correlating prior pulse history with future responses across single-cell clones tests whether history is stored and inherited rather than just reflecting current state.

ideas.title: Site-specific mutagenesis of AP-1 motifs at memory-associated enhancers
ideas.description: Use CRISPR base editing or prime editing to mutate individual TRE/AP-1 motifs at candidate memory enhancers and measure, in the same cells, the effect on the persistence of chromatin opening and on the re-induction kinetics after a washout. Mutations that abolish memory while leaving the initial response intact would separate the storage function from the acute transcriptional function.

ideas.title: Biochemical test of self-sustaining AP-1 chromatin states and dilution
ideas.description: Track histone marks and AP-1/co-factor occupancy through cell division using pulse-chase labeling (e.g., SNAP-tag or Hdac/histone turnover reporters) and CUT&RUN or ChIP-seq with and without DNA replication. If AP-1 binding and the associated marks are re-established by sister chromatids or through inheritance of modified histones, that supports a self-propagating mechanism, whereas dilution after division indicates memory requires continuous AP-1 presence.
